script_text: Stop, Taurus! The Sun challenges your fixed Earth nature, and pretending harmony will not work today. The Sun in Libra occupies your 7th House and opposes your 1st House Taurus, while your Earth-sign ruler, Venus, retrogrades in your 8th House in Scorpio, activating trust, intimacy, and obligations today. In love, a direct, guarded admirer may appear through mutual friends; with a partner, an old control-versus-trust issue will surface, so ask instead of withdrawing. At work, 7th-House negotiations can stall if a client or colleague demands the old terms back. Venus in the 8th House flags contracts, shared expenses, taxes, and delayed payments, so check the fine print and put every number in writing. Bonus: honesty wins; avoid a jealous text or signing before verifying the figures. Follow for tomorrow's reading, and subscribe so you don't miss this week's turning points.
